about: KRI-1512 (follow-up to KRI-1507): the four ~1 s pauses Clean up speech still kept on the Cusco DJI T2 'list 1' take (prod job 887f89d6) after #2374. Independent truth, measured on the kit clip T2_numbered_labels/airdrop/T2_01.mp4 (16 kHz mono), never from whisper-1 or the silence spans: `voice_band` = voice-band level (highpass 300 Hz, lowpass 3400 Hz, 50 ms RMS, speech = 10 dB or more over the 10th-percentile floor); `voice_before` / `voice_after` = the KRI-1017 voicing detector's runs bounding the pause (`speech_voice_guard.voiced_runs` at the take's quiet floor); `heard` = local whisper.cpp large-v3-turbo (-l tr, -ml 1) on a short excerpt around the pause. `hum` (pause A) = per-frame (40 ms, 10 ms hop) level over the quiet floor, normalised autocorrelation in 80-1000 Hz and its pitch, over the stretch the voice guard heard; `other_pauses` = the same read over pauses B, C, D and the 2 s pause (13.5-15.2 s). `after_2374` = the cleanup plan with the late-word move (#2374) and without the stretched-word step, replayed on the real clip with the job's words (no paid call). Failure modes: docs/reviews/kri-1512-stretched-words-failure-modes.md.
